PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 10, 32, 38, 69, 70, 106, 121 and 127 of Block 06, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 620400, situated in the Village of Nivithigala within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 174 A - Yakdehiwaththa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Nivithigala, in the District of Ratnapura, in the Prov-ince of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in Notice No. 62/0458 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1986/38 of 29th September, 2016 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K. A. K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 28th February, 2018.
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
